identifier.rule: UCNS is a stable identifier. Any expansion is an alias or provenance description only and cannot become schema authority, mathematical canon, or implementation law.

project.system_root: UCNS assigns elements of an unknowable to completion through geometric motion.
project.completion_scope: Completion closes a declared construction relative to its declared boundary and does not exhaust the underlying unknowable.
project.objective: Expose UCNS choices and determine an EDCM-scoped ideal option configuration against real systems.
project.ucns_role: Provide explicit, versioned, composable, provenance-bearing choices without hidden global defaults.
project.edcm_role: Test configurations against declared systems and readouts, retain failures, and support an explicit EDCM-scoped selection decision.
project.selection_principle: Refuse early collapse. Run each admitted corpus in full, then surface the configurations and cases that expose incompleteness, disagreement, and worst-case behavior rather than flattering current examples.

decisions.statement: UCNS has no canonical expansion.
UCNS exposes choices as explicit configurations; registration or implementation does not appoint a global default.
Old and new lineages are decomposed into individual choices with evidence and standing rather than restored or rejected wholesale.
The current project uses EDCM experiments against real systems to determine an EDCM-scoped ideal UCNS configuration.
An EDCM-scoped selection does not become universal UCNS canon and transfers no theorem, EDCM measurement, or METAPAT validity.
Producer epoch, profile, bridge schema, source identity, and complete option values participate in configuration identity and must fail closed on mismatch.
The initial EDCM profile preserves order, multiplicity, occurrence identity, left-right sidedness, algebraic zero, and retained layers outside scalar support.
A changed or failed result is evidence about a choice boundary, not automatically a regression and not permission to rewrite earlier reports.
NA is distinct from numeric or structural zero.
EDCM requires the Mobius twist because its interpretation of space as singular and superpositioned supplies a load-bearing causal chain for later hyper-dimensional letter and word relations.
For EDCM, Structural Null is superpositioned space and the twist occurs when a new gonol initiates.
EDCM requires ordered concatenation; multiset and set views may exist only as explicit information-losing projections.
One complete speaker turn has one unit of EDCM support; token count, word count, and text extent do not alter that support.
Exact evidence is the EDCM baseline. Projection may increase only along an explicit sliding scale justified by accumulated experimental understanding and recorded information loss.
EDCM displays geometric-mean, maximum-support, and minimum-support M candidates together; no single M candidate is selected.
EDCM displays cell-log-support, cell-detail, and retained-presence B candidates together pending more information.
EDCM uses carrier pairing only; typed payload dispatch remains outside the active configuration pending more information.
The target configuration requires an EDCM-specific profile rather than a combined EDCM-METAPAT profile.
Real-system corpora are required before an EDCM option selection can close.
Every admitted corpus is run in full. Failure-seeking occurs in post-run comparison and surfacing, not by sampling a flattering or adversarial subset.
The word is the smallest EDCM gonol. Character tokens compose each word gonol, and every larger gonol must compose from word gonols without flattening the SPACE nesting boundary.
EDCM token identity is the exact public 157-position Unicode code-point fixture from The-Interdependency/a0-betatest at its recorded source commit and SHA-256 digest.

The EDCM source domain is Unicode scalar values: surrogate code points are rejected, while valid carrier-unassigned witnesses such as private-use U+E000, reserved U+0378, and noncharacter U+FDD0 remain exact ordered evidence rather than being coerced into carrier membership.
Every source code point in the profile-pinned Unicode White_Space set assigns to the U+0020 public-gonol origin while its exact source value, code point, and offset remain unchanged.
Authoritative EDCM evidence is never Unicode-normalized or folded. Exact source code points are preserved; any NFC view is a separately named comparison projection with recorded divergence.
EDCM configuration experiments run every turn in each admitted corpus. Sampling and holdout partitioning do not define the current execution protocol.
